title: Retro Snake
description: Feed your snake and avoid crashing into the walls or your own tail. Styled with bright retro arcade accents.

title: Cyber Pong
description: High-octane tabletop tennis with particle collision trails, customizable difficulty, and local split-screen controls.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Smash layers of retro blocks using bouncy energy power-ups, paddle modifications, and multi-ball triggers.

title: Retro Flappy
description: Flap through random, colorful pixel-art pipes in this fast-paced arcade velocity game.

title: Speed Math Challenge
description: Test your reflexes and basic operations under a ticking retro timer. Perfect for pretending to be studying!
